regression_gate: M0 (unit 53, integration 43, baseline 6) and M1 (unit 70, integration 18, e2e 4) suites must stay green
provider_policy: Deterministic suites use the fake model provider; one opt-in live-provider smoke test runs only when credentials are supplied (B1)

tests.requirement: One authenticated merchant request creates an AgentRun with parallel brand, catalogue-draft, storefront, image and offer tasks; run/task state, current step and progress visible via API and status stream
Worker killed and restarted mid-run: run resumes via lease expiry; completed tasks and completed tool calls are not repeated (idempotency keys)
Injected failure in one task leaves other tasks' results intact; retrying the failed task succeeds
Follow-up prompt during a running run is queued (PromptQueue) and processed in order; cancel and pause transitions behave per state machine
Every persistent change is a validated tool call with an AIAction audit row (tool, risk, actor, run/task, idempotency key, result)
Invalid, extra-field or out-of-schema model output is rejected with no side effects
Runs, tasks, actions, generations and business profiles are StoreEnvironment-owned; Store B run/task ids through Store A merchant API, status stream and tools are not found
Prompt injection (model output naming store_environment_id or another store's product/project ids) cannot select or touch another store
AI-generated products are drafts, invisible through the Store API and preview storefront until confirmation; provenance recorded; no invented prices or stock
Generated storefront config validates against storefront-schema v2; invalid config is rejected
E2E: generation triggers a real preview deployment that renders the generated brand and sections for its own store only
Images per D2 decision: tenant-prefixed storage, type/size validation, cross-store file ids rejected (TENANCY §12 media invariant)
Run budgets (tokens/time/tool calls/concurrency) enforced per D8 defaults
Preview deployments execute through the durable worker, replacing M1 in-process execution; M1 deployment isolation tests still pass
Opt-in live-provider smoke: a real model produces valid tool calls for a Bulgarian sample merchant end to end
